# Albright Innovations

> Albright Innovations helps small and medium businesses with their marketing and the systems behind it. We manage social media, Facebook and Instagram ads, Google Business Profiles and websites. We set up a 24/7 assistant that answers website enquiries and sends the lead to the owner, and we improve the systems behind the scenes: customer lists, phones, scheduling, quoting, invoicing, follow-up and lead tracking. Based in Big Rapids, Michigan and the Charlotte, North Carolina area, working with businesses anywhere in the U.S.

Tagline: Authentic Influence. Founder: Joshua Albright. Email: joshua@albright-innovations.com. Website: https://albright-innovations.com/

## Services

- [Operations check](https://albright-innovations.com/what-we-do/#operations-check): A walk-through of how work moves through your business, from the first call to the final invoice, and where time and leads slip away.
- [A 24/7 assistant for your website](https://albright-innovations.com/what-we-do/#assistant): Answers common questions on your website, takes the customer's details and sends them to you right away, day or night.
- [The right tools for how you work](https://albright-innovations.com/what-we-do/#tools): Customer list, scheduling, phones, quoting, invoicing and job tracking, chosen to fit how you work and the tools you already have.
- [Workflows and follow-up](https://albright-innovations.com/what-we-do/#workflows): Clear steps from first call to close to follow-up, so nothing depends on someone remembering.
- [Lead tracking and reporting](https://albright-innovations.com/what-we-do/#lead-tracking): Working out where your customers come from, so you know which ads, posts and referrals bring in paying work.
- [Social media management](https://albright-innovations.com/what-we-do/#social-media): Posts planned, scheduled and answered, so your page stays active without you living on it.
- [Google Business Profile and reviews](https://albright-innovations.com/what-we-do/#google-business): Your Google listing kept current, with posts and a steady way of asking customers for reviews, within Google's rules.
- [Social ads](https://albright-innovations.com/what-we-do/#social-ads): Facebook and Instagram ads aimed at people in your area.
- [Websites](https://albright-innovations.com/what-we-do/#websites): A clean, current site that tells people who you are, what you do and how to reach you.

## Free tools

- [Where does your week go?](https://albright-innovations.com/#time): Add up the hours you spend on quotes, scheduling, invoicing, retyping and social media, and see what they cost per year.
- [Missed-call calculator](https://albright-innovations.com/#calls): Estimate the jobs and revenue at risk from unanswered calls and slow follow-up.

## Answers to common questions

- [How much time do small business owners spend on admin?](https://albright-innovations.com/answers/how-much-time-do-small-business-owners-spend-on-admin/): In one 2023 survey of 251 U.S. business owners, admin took 36% of a 45.5-hour work week, about 16 hours.
- [What does a missed call cost a small business?](https://albright-innovations.com/answers/what-does-a-missed-call-cost-a-small-business/): A missed call costs you the chance at a job. To put a number on it, multiply the calls you miss by how often a call becomes work, then by your average job value. For a business getting 30 calls a week and missing 40% of them, that's roughly 21 jobs a month at risk.
- [How fast should I respond to a new lead?](https://albright-innovations.com/answers/how-fast-should-i-respond-to-a-new-lead/): Within five minutes if you can, and within the hour at the latest. In a study of 2,241 U.S. companies, those that reached a new lead within an hour were nearly seven times as likely to qualify it as those that waited longer ( Harvard Business Review, 2011 ).
- [Do I need a CRM for a small business, and what's the simplest place to start?](https://albright-innovations.com/answers/do-i-need-a-crm-for-a-small-business/): Our take: once you have more than a few dozen customers, it's worth having one, and it doesn't need to be fancy. A CRM is a customer list with the history attached, and the simplest place to start is one shared spreadsheet with six columns.
- [How often should a local business post on Facebook?](https://albright-innovations.com/answers/how-often-should-a-local-business-post-on-facebook/): Our rule of thumb is at least once a week, and two to three times a week if you can keep it up. There's no study we know of that sets an exact number for local businesses. Hootsuite recommends brands post 1 to 2 times a day on Facebook, and says quality matters more than quantity ( Hootsuite, 2025 ).
- [Is it worth paying someone to manage our social media?](https://albright-innovations.com/answers/is-it-worth-paying-someone-to-manage-our-social-media/): It's worth it when the hours you'd spend are worth more than the fee, or when the posting isn't happening at all. Three hours a week at $75 an hour is $11,700 a year of your time.
- [How do I know which ads or posts are bringing in customers?](https://albright-innovations.com/answers/how-do-i-know-which-ads-or-posts-bring-in-customers/): Give each ad or post its own trail: a separate phone number, a tagged link, or a "how did you hear about us" that gets written down every single time. Then match each job back to the trail it came in on.
- [When is it time to redo my business website?](https://albright-innovations.com/answers/when-is-it-time-to-redo-my-business-website/): When it no longer does its three jobs: tell people what you do, show them you're real and current, and make it easy to reach you. Our rule of thumb: if it's more than three years old, awkward on a phone, or shows old hours, prices or photos, it's worth a hard look.
- [What should a small business website have on it?](https://albright-innovations.com/answers/what-should-a-small-business-website-have-on-it/): Six things: what you do, where you do it, proof you're real (your photos, your name, your reviews), a way to contact you on every page, current hours and prices where they apply, and a site that works on a phone.
- [What does an operations check involve?](https://albright-innovations.com/answers/what-does-an-operations-check-involve/): A walk-through of how work moves through your business, from the first call to the final invoice. The operations check takes about 30 minutes, and you get a one-page list of what we'd fix first.
- [Do you work with businesses anywhere in the country?](https://albright-innovations.com/answers/do-you-work-with-businesses-anywhere/): Yes. Based in Big Rapids, Michigan and the Charlotte, North Carolina area, working with businesses anywhere in the U.S. Most of the work happens online, so where you are matters less than what you need.
- [What does it cost to work with Albright Innovations?](https://albright-innovations.com/answers/what-does-it-cost-to-work-with-albright-innovations/): It depends on the scope, and we figure it out together before you commit to anything. The first conversation and the operations check don't cost anything, and you'll have a price in writing before any work starts.
